subject.title: [Bug]: macOS onboarding rejects a logged-in Codex CLI on fresh installs

question: Should maintainers continue with the open fixing PR for this macOS Codex onboarding blocker, or replace it with a narrower setup-inference ordering fix?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and narrow, but the issue has a protected `maintainer` label and an open closing PR with merge/proof follow-up, so automation should not queue or close it without maintainer intent.

options.title: Finish the open fixing PR
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102637, resolve its blockers, and close this issue through the merged PR.

options.title: Sponsor a narrower fix
options.body: Close or pause the broad PR and land a focused setup-inference ordering patch with macOS Codex onboarding proof.

recommendation.title: Finish the open fixing PR
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102637, resolve its blockers, and close this issue through the merged PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to this issue and have the strongest recent history on the implicated onboarding and Codex setup paths.
